headline: Brazil Confirms New Newcastle Disease Outbreak, Prompting Export Bans
summary: Brazil confirmed a third outbreak of Newcastle disease in Santa Catarina, prompting international buyers from Mexico to China to restrict poultry imports.
why: Brazil is one of the world's largest exporters of poultry. Animal disease outbreaks lead to immediate trade restrictions, impacting domestic agricultural revenues and global protein supplies.

impacts.name: Brazilian Poultry Exporters
impacts.why: Import bans by major trading partners halt foreign sales of poultry products, reducing export volumes for domestic producers.
